import os
from collections.abc import Generator
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List
from typing import TypedDict
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from agent.schemas.profile_v1 import Closer
from agent.schemas.profile_v1 import Job
from agent.schemas.profile_v1 import Organization
from agent.schemas.profile_v1 import Profile
from agent.services.container import ServiceContainer
from agent.services.interfaces import ILiveKitService
from agent.services.interfaces import IPurplefishService
from agent.services.interfaces.purplefish_service import Engagement
from tests.schemas.test_models import ScriptField
from tests.schemas.test_models import ScriptNode
from tests.schemas.test_models import ScriptTree


class TestData(TypedDict):
    """Type for the mock test data fixture."""

    profile: Profile
    organization: Organization
    job: Job
    engagement: Engagement
    script_tree: ScriptTree


# Set default OPENAI_API_KEY for tests
os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"] = (
    os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
    if "OPENAI_API_KEY" in os.environ
    else "test_openai_key"
)


# ==================== Service Fixtures ====================


@pytest.fixture
def mock_services() -> ServiceContainer:
    """Create a mock ServiceContainer with properly spec'd services."""
    # Create mock services with proper specs
    mock_livekit = Mock(spec=ILiveKitService)
    mock_purplefish = Mock(spec=IPurplefishService)

    # Set up the async methods we need
    mock_purplefish.post_engagement_agent_task_event = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.get_candidate_profile = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.post_message = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.create_engagement = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.post_engagement_script_node = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.get_engagement_completion = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.update_engagement = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.request_transfer = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.update_transfer_status = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.update_profile_schedule = AsyncMock()
    mock_purplefish.get_transfers_by_receiver = AsyncMock(return_value=[])
    mock_purplefish.get_transfers_by_engagement = AsyncMock(return_value=[])

    # Set up livekit async methods
    mock_livekit.hangup = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.delete_room = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.create_sip_participant = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.create_sip_participant_and_wait_for_pickup = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.start_room_composite_egress = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.stop_egress = AsyncMock()
    mock_livekit.remove_participant = AsyncMock()

    return ServiceContainer(
        livekit_service=mock_livekit, purplefish_service=mock_purplefish
    )


# ==================== Data Model Fixtures ====================


@pytest.fixture
def mock_profile() -> Profile:
    """Create a mock Profile for testing."""
    return Profile(
        id="profile_123",
        firstName="John",
        lastName="Doe",
        phoneNumber="1234567890",
        candidateApplied=True,
        timezone="America/Chicago",
        agentVersion="2.0.0",
    )


@pytest.fixture
def mock_organization() -> Organization:
    """Create a mock Organization for testing."""
    return Organization(
        id="org_123",
        name="IniCorp",
        agentName="Tes",
        agentInstructions="The following are instructions specifically for the organization you are conducting the interview for: Candidate questions: a) If the candidate asks about the company or role, acknowledge their question and promise to forward it to the hiring manager. b) Do not attempt to answer candidate questions.",
    )


@pytest.fixture
def mock_job() -> Job:
    """Create a mock Job for testing."""
    return Job(
        id="job_123",
        companyName="IniCorp",
        title="Software Engineer",
        location="Chicago, IL",
    )


@pytest.fixture
def mock_engagement() -> Engagement:
    """Create a mock Engagement for testing."""
    return Engagement(
        id="engagement_123",
        profileId="profile_123",
        createdAt=datetime(2024, 3, 15, 10, 0),
        updatedAt=datetime(2024, 3, 15, 10, 0),
    )


@pytest.fixture
def mock_closer() -> Closer:
    """Create a mock Closer for testing."""
    return Closer(
        firstName="Jane",
        lastName="Smith",
        phoneNumber="9876543210",
        timezone="America/New_York",
    )


@pytest.fixture
def mock_script_tree() -> ScriptTree:
    """Create a mock ScriptTree for testing."""
    root_node = ScriptNode(
        id="root",
        type="root",
        content="Welcome to the interview",
        children=[
            ScriptNode(
                id="q1",
                type="question",
                content="Tell me about yourself",
                fields=[
                    ScriptField(key="answer", description="Candidate's background")
                ],
                children=[],
            ),
            ScriptNode(
                id="q2",
                type="question",
                content="Why are you interested in this role?",
                fields=[
                    ScriptField(key="motivation", description="Candidate's motivation")
                ],
                children=[],
            ),
        ],
    )
    return ScriptTree(root=root_node)


# ==================== LiveKit Fixtures ====================


@pytest.fixture
def mock_job_context() -> JobContext:
    """Create a mock JobContext for testing."""
    ctx = Mock(spec=JobContext)
    ctx.job = Mock()
    ctx.job.id = "test_job_id"
    ctx.job.room = Mock()
    ctx.job.room.name = "test_room"
    ctx.room = ctx.job.room  # Some tests expect ctx.room directly
    return ctx


@pytest.fixture
def mock_session() -> MagicMock:
    """Create a mock session with common setup."""
    session = MagicMock()

    # Create a mock speech handle with wait_for_playout method
    speech_handle = MagicMock()
    speech_handle.wait_for_playout = AsyncMock()
    session.say = AsyncMock(return_value=speech_handle)

    # Set up userdata
    session.userdata = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx.shutdown = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx.job = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx.job.id = "test_job_id"
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx.room = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.agent_manager.ctx.room.name = "test_room"
    session.userdata.agent_manager.done = AsyncMock(return_value=None)
    session.userdata.language = "en-US"  # Add default language

    # Add common attributes
    session.userdata.engagement = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.services = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.profile = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.job = MagicMock()
    session.userdata.organization = MagicMock()

    return session


# ==================== Utility Fixtures ====================


@pytest.fixture
def mock_time() -> Generator[MagicMock, None, None]:
    """Mock time.monotonic() to return a fixed value."""
    with patch("time.monotonic", return_value=1234567890.0) as mock:
        yield mock


@pytest.fixture
def mock_datetime_now() -> Generator[MagicMock, None, None]:
    """Mock datetime.now() to return a fixed datetime."""
    fixed_datetime = datetime(2024, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0)
    with patch("datetime.datetime") as mock_dt:
        mock_dt.now.return_value = fixed_datetime
        mock_dt.side_effect = lambda *args, **kw: datetime(*args, **kw)
        yield mock_dt


# ==================== Composite Fixtures ====================


@pytest.fixture
def mock_test_data(
    mock_profile: Profile,
    mock_organization: Organization,
    mock_job: Job,
    mock_engagement: Engagement,
    mock_script_tree: ScriptTree,
) -> TestData:
    """Composite fixture that provides all common test data."""
    return {
        "profile": mock_profile,
        "organization": mock_organization,
        "job": mock_job,
        "engagement": mock_engagement,
        "script_tree": mock_script_tree,
    }


# ==================== Pytest Configuration ====================

# Register custom markers
pytest_plugins: List[str] = []


def pytest_configure(config: pytest.Config) -> None:
    """Register custom pytest markers."""
    config.addinivalue_line("markers", "integration: mark test as an integration test")
    config.addinivalue_line("markers", "slow: mark test as slow running")
    config.addinivalue_line("markers", "unit: mark test as a unit test")


# ==================== Async Test Helpers ====================


@pytest.fixture
def event_loop_policy() -> None:
    """Set event loop policy for Windows compatibility."""
    if os.name == "nt":
        # Use ProactorEventLoop on Windows instead
        import asyncio

        asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsProactorEventLoopPolicy())  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

"""
Voice Agent Manager Implementation

Manage a full session of conversation
"""

import logging

from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.agents.voice.room_io.room_io import RoomInputOptions
from livekit.plugins import cartesia
from livekit.plugins import deepgram
from livekit.plugins import noise_cancellation
from livekit.plugins import openai
from livekit.plugins import silero
from livekit.plugins.turn_detector.multilingual import MultilingualModel

from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.schemas.config import VoiceAgentConfig
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState

from .utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentManager:
    """Multi-voice agent that manages conversation flow with voice switching"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: JobContext,
        call_script: CallScript,
        config: VoiceAgentConfig = VoiceAgentConfig(),
    ):
        ## Saving parameters
        self.ctx: JobContext = ctx
        self.call_script = call_script
        self.config = config

        ## setting up models
        self.speech_to_text = deepgram.STT(
            model=self.config.deepgram_model,
            language=self.config.deepgram_language,
        )
        self.text_to_speech = cartesia.TTS(
            model=self.config.cartesia_model,
            voice=self.config.default_cartesia_voice,
        )
        self.llm_model = openai.LLM(model=self.config.llm_model)
        self.vad_model = silero.VAD.load()

        ## Setting up Orchestrator
        self.session = AgentSession(
            stt=self.speech_to_text,
            llm=self.llm_model,
            tts=self.text_to_speech,
            vad=self.vad_model,
            turn_detection=MultilingualModel(),
            ## Only task agent can mutate data here
            userdata=SessionDataState(),
        )
        self.call_script_orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=self.call_script,
            session=self.session,
            on_finish_cleanup=self.on_finish,
        )

    async def start_session(self) -> None:
        """Start a conversation session"""
        await self.call_script_orchestrator.start(
            self.ctx,
            RoomInputOptions(
                noise_cancellation=noise_cancellation.BVC(),
            ),
        )

    async def on_finish(self, reason: str = "Call ended") -> None:
        try:
            self.ctx.shutdown(reason=reason)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error shutting down Voice Agent: {e}")

import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

from livekit.agents import JobContext
from voice_agent.manager import VoiceAgentManager
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.schemas.config import VoiceAgentConfig


class TestVoiceAgentManager:
    """Test suite for VoiceAgentManager"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_dependencies(self):
        """Mock all external dependencies"""
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.deepgram.STT") as mock_stt, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.cartesia.TTS") as mock_tts, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.openai.LLM") as mock_llm, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.silero.VAD") as mock_vad, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.CallScriptOrchestrator") as mock_orchestrator:
            
            # Configure mocks
            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())
            mock_session_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_session.return_value = mock_session_instance
            
            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_orchestrator_instance.start = AsyncMock()
            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance
            
            yield {
                "stt": mock_stt,
                "tts": mock_tts,
                "llm": mock_llm,
                "vad": mock_vad,
                "session": mock_session,
                "session_instance": mock_session_instance,
                "orchestrator": mock_orchestrator,
                "orchestrator_instance": mock_orchestrator_instance,
            }

    def test_initialization(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        voice_agent_config: VoiceAgentConfig,
        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test VoiceAgentManager initialization"""
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            config=voice_agent_config,
        )
        
        # Verify components are initialized
        assert manager.ctx == mock_job_context
        assert manager.call_script == sample_call_script
        assert manager.config == voice_agent_config
        
        # Verify STT initialization
        mock_dependencies["stt"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.deepgram_model,
            language=voice_agent_config.deepgram_language,
        )
        
        # Verify TTS initialization
        mock_dependencies["tts"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.cartesia_model,
            voice=voice_agent_config.default_cartesia_voice,
        )
        
        # Verify LLM initialization
        mock_dependencies["llm"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.llm_model
        )
        
        # Verify VAD initialization
        mock_dependencies["vad"].load.assert_called_once()
        
        # Verify orchestrator initialization
        mock_dependencies["orchestrator"].assert_called_once()

    def test_default_config(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test initialization with default config"""
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
        )
        
        # Should use default config values
        assert manager.config.llm_model == "gpt-4o-mini"
        assert manager.config.deepgram_model == "nova-2"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_session(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test starting a session"""
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
        )
        
        await manager.start_session()
        
        # Verify orchestrator start was called
        mock_dependencies["orchestrator_instance"].start.assert_called_once()
        call_args = mock_dependencies["orchestrator_instance"].start.call_args
        assert call_args[0][0] == mock_job_context

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_finish_normal(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test normal finish callback"""
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
        )
        
        await manager.on_finish("Test reason")
        
        # Verify shutdown was called
        mock_job_context.shutdown.assert_called_once_with(reason="Test reason")

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_finish_with_error(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_dependencies,
        caplog,
    ):
        """Test finish callback with error"""
        mock_job_context.shutdown.side_effect = Exception("Shutdown error")
        
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
        )
        
        await manager.on_finish("Test reason")
        
        # Should log the error
        assert "Error shutting down Voice Agent" in caplog.text

        # Result should still indicate success (messages were delivered)
        assert result.success is True

    async def test_say_error_handling(self, closer_agent: CloserAgent):
        """Test handling of say errors"""
        closer_agent.session.say = AsyncMock(side_effect=Exception("Say error"))
        closer_agent.session.close = AsyncMock()
        
        with pytest.raises(Exception, match="Say error"):
            await closer_agent.process_task("")
        
        # Session close should not be called if say fails
        closer_agent.session.close.assert_not_called()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_process_task_delay_after_last_message(self, closer_agent: CloserAgent):
        """Test that there's a delay after the last message before closing"""
        closer_agent.session.say = AsyncMock()
        closer_agent.session.close = AsyncMock()
        
        with patch("asyncio.sleep", new_callable=AsyncMock) as mock_sleep:
            await closer_agent.process_task("")
            
            # Should have 3 delays total (2 between messages + 1 before close)
            assert mock_sleep.call_count >= 2

import pytest
from voice_agent.utils.conversation_context import ConversationContext


class TestConversationContext:
    """Test suite for ConversationContext"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def context(self) -> ConversationContext:
        """Create a ConversationContext instance"""
        return ConversationContext()

    def test_initialization(self):
        """Test ConversationContext initialization"""
        context = ConversationContext(max_history=5)
        
        assert context.max_history == 5
        assert len(context.messages) == 0
        assert context.get_context() == []

    def test_default_initialization(self):
        """Test default initialization values"""
        context = ConversationContext()
        
        assert context.max_history == 10
        assert len(context.messages) == 0

    def test_add_message_user(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test adding user messages"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello there")
        
        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "user"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hello there"

    def test_add_message_assistant(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test adding assistant messages"""
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi! How can I help?")
        
        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "assistant"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hi! How can I help?"

    def test_add_message_system(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test adding system messages"""
        context.add_message("system", "You are a helpful assistant")
        
        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "system"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "You are a helpful assistant"

    def test_add_multiple_messages(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test adding multiple messages"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi there!")
        context.add_message("user", "How are you?")
        context.add_message("assistant", "I'm doing well, thanks!")
        
        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 4
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hello"
        assert messages[1]["content"] == "Hi there!"
        assert messages[2]["content"] == "How are you?"
        assert messages[3]["content"] == "I'm doing well, thanks!"

    def test_max_history_limit(self):
        """Test that max_history is enforced"""
        context = ConversationContext(max_history=3)
        
        # Add more messages than max_history
        context.add_message("user", "Message 1")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response 1")
        context.add_message("user", "Message 2")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response 2")
        context.add_message("user", "Message 3")
        
        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 3
        # Should keep the most recent messages
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Message 2"
        assert messages[1]["content"] == "Response 2"
        assert messages[2]["content"] == "Message 3"

    def test_clear_context(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test clearing conversation context"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi!")
        
        assert len(context.get_context()) == 2
        
        context.clear()
        
        assert len(context.get_context()) == 0

    def test_get_last_message(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last message"""
        context.add_message("user", "First")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Second")
        context.add_message("user", "Last")
        
        last = context.get_last_message()
        assert last is not None
        assert last["role"] == "user"
        assert last["content"] == "Last"

    def test_get_last_message_empty(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test getting last message from empty context"""
        last = context.get_last_message()
        assert last is None

    def test_get_last_user_message(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last user message"""
        context.add_message("user", "User 1")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response")
        context.add_message("user", "User 2")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Another response")
        
        last_user = context.get_last_user_message()
        assert last_user is not None
        assert last_user["content"] == "User 2"

    def test_get_last_assistant_message(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last assistant message"""
        context.add_message("user", "Question")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Answer 1")
        context.add_message("user", "Another question")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Answer 2")
        
        last_assistant = context.get_last_assistant_message()
        assert last_assistant is not None
        assert last_assistant["content"] == "Answer 2"

    def test_get_formatted_context(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test getting formatted context string"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi there!")
        
        formatted = context.get_formatted_context()
        assert "User: Hello" in formatted
        assert "Assistant: Hi there!" in formatted

    def test_empty_formatted_context(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test formatted context when empty"""
        formatted = context.get_formatted_context()
        assert formatted == ""

    def test_message_count(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test message counting"""
        assert context.message_count() == 0
        
        context.add_message("user", "Test")
        assert context.message_count() == 1
        
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response")
        assert context.message_count() == 2

    def test_get_messages_by_role(self, context: ConversationContext):
        """Test filtering messages by role"""
        context.add_message("user", "User 1")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Assistant 1")
        context.add_message("user", "User 2")
        context.add_message("system", "System 1")
        
        user_messages = context.get_messages_by_role("user")
        assert len(user_messages) == 2
        assert user_messages[0]["content"] == "User 1"
        assert user_messages[1]["content"] == "User 2"
        
        assistant_messages = context.get_messages_by_role("assistant")
        assert len(assistant_messages) == 1
        assert assistant_messages[0]["content"] == "Assistant 1"

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
from voice_agent.enums import TaskFailureBehavior
from voice_agent.enums import TaskValidationType


class TaskSuccessStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling successful completion of a task."""

    description: str = Field(
        description="Description of what constitutes success for this task"
    )


class TaskFailureStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling failed completion of a task."""

    failure_reason: str = Field(description="Reason why this task failed")


class TaskFailureRetryStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling retry of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY, description="Behavior to retry the agent"
    )
    max_attempts: int = Field(description="Maximum number of retry attempts allowed")


class TaskFailureSkipStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP, description="Behavior to skip to next task"
    )
    # proceed with next task if none provided
    next_task_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="ID of the next task to execute after skipping, if none provided proceeds with default next task",
    )


class TaskFailureEndCallStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling call ending of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL, description="Behavior to end the call"
    )


class TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling validation of a task."""

    strategy: Literal[TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY] = Field(
        default=TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY,
        description="Type of validation strategy to use",
    )
    query: str = Field(description="JSONata query string for validating datapoints")
    instructions_on_failure: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for the agent to follow"
    )
    can_end_call: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether the call can be ended if the validation fails",
    )


class BaseTaskConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """General Task Configuration"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for this call task")
    title: str = Field(description="Human-readable title for this task")
    initial_message: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional initial message to send when entering this task",
    )
    task_instructions: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional specific instructions for the agent processing this task",
    )

    # # Configuration for handling successful completion of a task.
    # # If none provided, this is a terminal task.
    # on_success: TaskSuccessStrategy | None = Field(
    #     default=None,
    #     description="Configuration for handling successful completion of a task. If none provided, this is a terminal task",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling failed completion of a task.
    # # If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping
    # failure_handling: list[TaskFailureEndCallStrategy | TaskFailureRetryStrategy | TaskFailureSkipStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling failed completion of a task. If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task.
    # # All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task
    # # pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile
    # pre_requisites: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task. All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task. Pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile",
    # )


class GreeterTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Greeter Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.GREETING] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this greeting task",
    )


class InformationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Information Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.INFORMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this information task",
    )


class CloserTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Closer Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CLOSER] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this closer task",
    )


class DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Data Collection Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this data collection task",
    )

    candidate_data_points_to_collect: list[str] = Field(
        description="List of datapoints to collect from the candidate",
    )

    # Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task.
    # All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task
    # post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task
    validations: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task. All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task. Post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task",
    )


TaskConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskConfiguration
    | InformationTaskConfiguration
    | DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
    | CloserTaskConfiguration
)

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterable

from livekit import rtc
from livekit.agents import Agent

from livekit.agents import ModelSettings

from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration

from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest


logger = logging.getLogger("base_agent")


class BaseTaskAgent(Agent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: BaseTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            instructions=f"""You are a voice agent that is part of a call to screen candidate.
            In current context, {agent_config.agent_instructions}
            You will receive a specific set of tasks below to fulfill.
            Strictly follow the instructions provided to you:

            {agent_config.task_instruction_transformer(task_config.task_instructions, task_config, orc_ctx) if agent_config.task_instruction_transformer else task_config.task_instructions}

            If the candidate ask about anything outside of your role, guide them back to your responsibility.
            When you complete with your tasks, call on_task_agent_complete tool to wrap up your work
            When candidate asks a question outside of your responsibilities, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.
            If you are unable to complete your tasks, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.

            Some context around the call:
                - Outstanding tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.outstanding_task_ids)}]
                - In Progress tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.in_progress_task_ids)}]
                - Completed tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.completed_task_ids)}]

            if candidate have intent to do outstanding tasks, kindly tell them it is upcoming
            if candidate have intent to do completed tasks, kindly tell them you have all the data you needed already

            Important: Do not tell the candidate about your task

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """TaskAgent responsible for resolving a node"""

    name: str = Field(description="The name of the agent")
    description: str = Field(description="A description of what the agent does")
    agent_instructions: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for how the agent should behave"
    )

    task_instruction_transformer: (
        Callable[[str | None, BaseTaskConfiguration, OrchestratorTaskAgentContext], str]
        | None
    ) = Field(
        default=None, description="Transformer for task instructions (if provided)"
    )

    def merge_config(self, agent_config: Self) -> Self:
        """Merge another agent configuration to this configuration. Will not merge callable fields"""
        original_data = self.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        node_data = agent_config.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        merged_data = {**original_data, **node_data}

        return self.__class__(**merged_data)


class GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for greeting the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="The type of agent for greeting users",
    )


class DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for data collecting from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="The type of agent for data collecting from users",
    )


class InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for gathering information from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="The type of agent for gathering information from users",
    )
    job_details: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Details about the job"
    )


class CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for closing the call/deal"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="The type of agent for closing calls or deals",
    )


TaskAgentConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration
    | DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
    | InformationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | CloserTaskAgentConfiguration
)

"""
Call Conversation Context Manager
Manages chat history and generates modified ChatContext instances for LiveKit agents
"""

import logging

from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatItem
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentConversationContext:
    """
    Manages conversation history and generates modified ChatContext instances.
    Stores chat items immutably and applies modifications only when generating output.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize empty conversation context"""
        self._items: list[ChatItem] = []
        self._item_ids: set[str] = set()  # Track seen item IDs to avoid duplicates

    def update_from_chat_context(self, chat_ctx: ChatContext) -> None:
        """
        Update internal storage with new items from LiveKit's ChatContext.
        Only adds items that haven't been seen before.

        Args:
            chat_ctx: LiveKit ChatContext to sync from
        """
        if not chat_ctx or not chat_ctx.items:
            return

        added_count = 0
        for item in chat_ctx.items:
            # Check if item has an ID and hasn't been seen
            if isinstance(item, ChatMessage) and hasattr(item, "id"):
                if item.id and item.id not in self._item_ids:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    self._item_ids.add(item.id)
                    added_count += 1
            else:
                # For items without IDs, check if it's already in our list
                # This is a simple check - you might want more sophisticated duplicate detection
                if item not in self._items:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    added_count += 1

        if added_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Added {added_count} new items from ChatContext, total: {len(self._items)}"
            )

    def _remove_last_user_responses(self, items: list[ChatItem]) -> list[ChatItem]:
        """
        Remove messages from the end while the last message has role 'user'.

        Args:
            items: List of chat items to process

        Returns:
            Modified list with trailing user messages removed
        """
        original_length = len(items)
        while items:
            last_item = items[-1]
            if (
                isinstance(last_item, ChatMessage)
                and hasattr(last_item, "role")
                and last_item.role == "user"
            ):
                items.pop()
            else:
                break

        removed_count = original_length - len(items)
        if removed_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Removed {removed_count} messages from the end (last message role was 'user')"
            )

        return items

    def generate_context(
        self,
        remove_last_user_responses: bool = False,
    ) -> ChatContext:
        """
        Generate a ChatContext with optional modification.

        Args:
            remove_last_user_responses: If True, removes messages from the end until the most recent message no longer has role 'user'

        Returns:
            Modified ChatContext for use with LiveKit agents
        """
        # Start with a copy of items
        items = self._items.copy()

        if remove_last_user_responses:
            items = self._remove_last_user_responses(items)

        logger.debug(
            f"Generated context with {len(items)} items "
            f"(original: {len(self._items)}, remove_last_user={remove_last_user_responses})"
        )

        return ChatContext(items=items)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear all stored conversation history"""
        self._items.clear()
        self._item_ids.clear()
        logger.info("Conversation context cleared")

    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]:
        """
        Create a snapshot of current state for potential rollback.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (items copy, item_ids copy)
        """
        return (self._items.copy(), self._item_ids.copy())

    def restore(self, snapshot: tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]) -> None:
        """
        Restore from a previously created snapshot.

        Args:
            snapshot: Tuple from snapshot() method
        """
        self._items, self._item_ids = snapshot
        logger.info(f"Restored conversation context to {len(self._items)} items")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"VoiceAgentConversationContext(items={len(self._items)}, unique_ids={len(self._item_ids)})"

"""Simple tests for voice_agent module that match actual implementation"""

import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

from livekit.agents import JobContext


class TestVoiceAgentSimple:
    """Simple tests for voice agent components"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_manager_initialization(self):
        """Test basic VoiceAgentManager initialization"""
        # Mock all dependencies
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.deepgram.STT") as mock_stt, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.cartesia.TTS") as mock_tts, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.openai.LLM") as mock_llm, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.silero.VAD") as mock_vad, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.CallScriptOrchestrator") as mock_orchestrator:
            
            # Configure mocks
            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())
            mock_session_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_session.return_value = mock_session_instance
            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance
            
            # Create mock context
            ctx = Mock(spec=JobContext)
            ctx.job = Mock()
            ctx.job.id = "test_job"
            ctx.shutdown = Mock()
            
            # Create mock call script
            call_script = MagicMock()
            call_script.tasks = []
            
            # Import and create manager
            from voice_agent.manager import VoiceAgentManager
            
            manager = VoiceAgentManager(ctx=ctx, call_script=call_script)
            
            # Verify basic initialization
            assert manager.ctx == ctx
            assert manager.call_script == call_script
            
            # Verify components were initialized
            mock_stt.assert_called_once()
            mock_tts.assert_called_once()
            mock_llm.assert_called_once()
            mock_vad.load.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_conversation_context(self):
        """Test VoiceAgentConversationContext"""
        from voice_agent.utils.conversation_context import VoiceAgentConversationContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage
        
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()
        
        # Test initial state
        assert len(context._items) == 0
        assert len(context._item_ids) == 0
        
        # Test adding items via chat context
        chat_ctx = ChatContext(items=[
            ChatMessage.create(role="user", id="msg1", text="Hello"),
            ChatMessage.create(role="assistant", id="msg2", text="Hi there"),
        ])
        
        context.update_from_chat_context(chat_ctx)
        assert len(context._items) == 2
        
        # Test generating context
        generated = context.generate_context()
        assert len(generated.items) == 2
        
        # Test clearing
        context.clear()
        assert len(context._items) == 0

    @pytest.mark.asyncio 
    async def test_base_task_agent(self):
        """Test BaseTaskAgent initialization"""
        from voice_agent.task_agent.base_agent import BaseTaskAgent
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import BaseTaskAgentConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
        
        # Create configurations
        agent_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test Agent",
            description="Test agent for testing",
            agent_instructions="Test instructions",
        )
        
        task_config = BaseTaskConfiguration(
            id="test_task",
            title="Test Task",
            task_instructions="Do something",
        )
        
        orc_ctx = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            outstanding_task_ids=["task1", "task2"],
            in_progress_task_ids=["task3"],
            completed_task_ids=["task4"],
        )
        
        # Create agent
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        
        # Verify initialization
        assert agent is not None
        assert "Test instructions" in agent.instructions

    def test_task_configurations(self):
        """Test task configuration schemas"""
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import GreeterTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import InformationTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import CloserTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
        
        # Test Greeter Configuration
        greeter = GreeterTaskConfiguration(
            id="greet",
            title="Greeting",
            task_instructions="Greet the user",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        )
        assert greeter.id == "greet"
        assert greeter.task_agent_type == TaskAgentType.GREETING
        
        # Test Data Collection Configuration
        data_collection = DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect",
            title="Collect Data",
            task_instructions="Collect user data",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
        )
        assert data_collection.id == "collect"
        assert len(data_collection.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 2
        
        # Test Information Configuration
        info = InformationTaskConfiguration(
            id="info",
            title="Provide Info",
            task_instructions="Give information",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        )
        assert info.id == "info"
        
        # Test Closer Configuration
        closer = CloserTaskConfiguration(
            id="close",
            title="Close Call",
            task_instructions="End the call",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        )
        assert closer.id == "close"

    def test_call_script_schema(self):

        from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
        from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScriptContext

        from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import GreeterTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
        
        # Create a call script
        script = CallScript(
            id="test_script",
            call_script_schema_version="1.0",
            call_script_version="1.0",
            candidate_data_point_schemas={
                "name": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                    description="User name",
                    datatype="string",
                    required=True,
                ),
            },
            context=CallScriptContext(
                job=JobContext(
                    title="Test Job",
                    description="Test job description",
                    company="TestCorp",
                ),
            ),
            tasks=[
                GreeterTaskConfiguration(
                    id="greet",
                    title="Greeting",
                    task_instructions="Greet user",
                    task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
                ),
            ],
        )
        
        assert script.id == "test_script"
        assert len(script.tasks) == 1
        assert script.context.job.title == "Test Job"

from collections.abc import Awaitable

from typing import Any

from livekit.agents import ChatContext
from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import ConfigDict
from pydantic import Field

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class TaskAgentInterruptRequest(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Feedback from an agent as it is processing a task"""

    type: TaskAgentInterruptType = Field(description="Type of the interruption")
    interrupt_note: str = Field(
        description="Interruption note to allow orchestrator to handle"
    )


class OrchestratorFailedTask(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living state of a task in the orchestrator"""

    id: str = Field(description="ID of the task")
    reason: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Reason for the task state (if any)"
    )


class SessionDataState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a Voice Agent, contains collected data from user and only modifiable by the agent"""

    current_node_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="The current node id of the call script"
    )

    candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate during the call",
    )

    current_agent_interruption: TaskAgentInterruptRequest | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Current interruption (if any) from the agent"
    )

class TestVoiceAgentSimple:
    """Simple tests for voice agent components"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_manager_initialization(self):
        """Test basic VoiceAgentManager initialization"""
        # Mock all dependencies
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.deepgram.STT") as mock_stt, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.cartesia.TTS") as mock_tts, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.openai.LLM") as mock_llm, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.silero.VAD") as mock_vad, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.MultilingualModel") as mock_multilingual, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.CallScriptOrchestrator") as mock_orchestrator:
            
            # Configure mocks
            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())
            mock_session_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_session.return_value = mock_session_instance
            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance
            
            # Create mock context
            ctx = Mock(spec=JobContext)
            ctx.job = Mock()
            ctx.job.id = "test_job"
            ctx.shutdown = Mock()
            
            # Create mock call script
            call_script = MagicMock()
            call_script.tasks = []
            
            # Import and create manager
            from voice_agent.manager import VoiceAgentManager
            
            manager = VoiceAgentManager(ctx=ctx, call_script=call_script)
            
            # Verify basic initialization
            assert manager.ctx == ctx
            assert manager.call_script == call_script
            
            # Verify components were initialized
            mock_stt.assert_called_once()
            mock_tts.assert_called_once()
            mock_llm.assert_called_once()
            mock_vad.load.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_conversation_context(self):
        """Test VoiceAgentConversationContext"""
        from voice_agent.utils.conversation_context import VoiceAgentConversationContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage
        
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()
        
        # Test initial state
        assert len(context._items) == 0
        assert len(context._item_ids) == 0
        
        # Test adding items via chat context
        msg1 = ChatMessage(role="user", text="Hello")
        msg1.id = "msg1"
        msg2 = ChatMessage(role="assistant", text="Hi there")
        msg2.id = "msg2"
        chat_ctx = ChatContext(items=[msg1, msg2])
        
        context.update_from_chat_context(chat_ctx)
        assert len(context._items) == 2
        
        # Test generating context
        generated = context.generate_context()
        assert len(generated.items) == 2
        
        # Test clearing
        context.clear()
        assert len(context._items) == 0

        from voice_agent.schemas.task import GreeterTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import InformationTaskConfiguration
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import CloserTaskConfiguration

        from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition

                    description="User name",
                    datatype="string",
                    required=True,

            },
            context=CallScriptContext(
                job=JobContext(
                    title="Test Job",
                    description="Test job description",
                    company="TestCorp",

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_manager_initialization(self):
        """Test basic VoiceAgentManager initialization"""
        # Mock all dependencies
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.deepgram.STT") as mock_stt, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.cartesia.TTS") as mock_tts, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.openai.LLM") as mock_llm, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.silero.VAD") as mock_vad, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.MultilingualModel") as mock_multilingual, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.CallScriptOrchestrator") as mock_orchestrator:
            
            # Configure mocks
            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())
            mock_session_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_session.return_value = mock_session_instance
            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance
            
            # Create mock context
            ctx = Mock(spec=JobContext)
            ctx.job = Mock()
            ctx.job.id = "test_job"
            ctx.shutdown = Mock()
            
            # Create mock call script
            call_script = MagicMock()
            call_script.tasks = []
            
            # Import and create manager
            from voice_agent.manager import VoiceAgentManager
            
            manager = VoiceAgentManager(ctx=ctx, call_script=call_script)
            
            # Verify basic initialization
            assert manager.ctx == ctx
            assert manager.call_script == call_script
            
            # Verify components were initialized
            mock_stt.assert_called_once()
            mock_tts.assert_called_once()
            mock_llm.assert_called_once()
            mock_vad.load.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_conversation_context(self):
        """Test VoiceAgentConversationContext"""
        from voice_agent.utils.conversation_context import VoiceAgentConversationContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
        from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage
        
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()
        
        # Test initial state
        assert len(context._items) == 0
        assert len(context._item_ids) == 0
        
        # Test adding items via chat context
        msg1 = ChatMessage(role="user", text="Hello")
        msg1.id = "msg1"
        msg2 = ChatMessage(role="assistant", text="Hi there")
        msg2.id = "msg2"
        chat_ctx = ChatContext(items=[msg1, msg2])
        
        context.update_from_chat_context(chat_ctx)
        assert len(context._items) == 2
        
        # Test generating context
        generated = context.generate_context()
        assert len(generated.items) == 2
        
        # Test clearing
        context.clear()
        assert len(context._items) == 0

    async def test_process_task_success(self, data_collection_agent: DataCollectionAgent):
        """Test successful data collection"""
        data_collection_agent.session.say = AsyncMock()
        
        # Mock validate_data_points to return success
        with patch.object(
            data_collection_agent,
            "validate_data_points",
            return_value=(True, {"name": "John Doe", "email": "john@example.com"}, [])
        ):
            result = await data_collection_agent.process_task("My name is John Doe and email is john@example.com")
        
        assert result.success is True
        assert result.collected_data == {"name": "John Doe", "email": "john@example.com"}

    async def test_prompt_construction(self, data_collection_agent: DataCollectionAgent):
        """Test that prompts are constructed correctly"""
        user_message = "Test message"
        
        # Spy on the LLM call
        original_complete = data_collection_agent.llm.complete
        data_collection_agent.llm.complete = AsyncMock(
            side_effect=lambda messages, **kwargs: original_complete(messages, **kwargs)
        )

        # Verify prompt includes data points info

        # Check that system message includes data point descriptions

        assert any("Test message" in str(msg) for msg in messages)

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

This is the Purplefish AI voice agent - a LiveKit-based phone agent for conducting automated voice interviews. The agent uses WebRTC for real-time communication, Deepgram for speech-to-text, and various TTS providers (Cartesia, Google).

## Essential Commands

We have a `Makefile` that simplifies common tasks. Here are the key commands:

### Development
- `make dev` - Run the agent in development mode
- `make test` - Run all tests
- `make test path=tests/path/to/test.py::test_name` - Run specific test
- `make download-files` - Download required model files (run after initial setup)

### Code Quality
- `make check` - Run all linting and formatting checks
- uv manages dependencies - use `uv add` for new packages
- Type checking is strict (mypy with strict=true)

## Architecture

The agent initialization flow:

1. **CLI Entry**: `agent/__init__.py` - Main entry point that parses commands (start, dev, chat, simulate, replay)
2. **Agent Setup**: `agent/entrypoint.py` - Sets up LiveKit room, loads AI components, creates CallController
3. **Call Management**: `agent/call_controller.py` - Manages voice conversations using AgentManager
4. **Agent Stack**: `agent/agent_manager.py` - Manages transitions between different agent types

Key components:
- **Agent Types** (`agent/agents/`): Different conversation handlers (question, reschedule, transfer, etc.)
- **Services** (`agent/services/`): External integrations with LiveKit, Purplefish API, analytics
- **Schemas** (`agent/schemas/`): Data models for profiles, jobs, scripts, and user data
- **Script Nodes**: Define conversation flow, converted to agents at runtime

Key patterns:
- All code is async (asyncio)
- Service interfaces separate external dependencies
- Agent stack allows dynamic conversation state changes
- Extensive Pydantic usage for data validation

## Testing

Tests use pytest with async support. The codebase includes:
- Unit tests for individual components
- Integration tests for agent behaviors
- Simulation tools for end-to-end testing without real calls

When writing tests:
- Use `pytest.mark.asyncio` for async tests
- Mock external services via service interfaces
- Test files should mirror source structure

## Environment Configuration

The project uses 1Password CLI for secrets management. Environment files are in `envs/`:
- Development uses `envs/development.env`
- All commands automatically load appropriate env via `op run`
- Never commit secrets - use 1Password references

## Key Dependencies

- LiveKit SDK and plugins for WebRTC
- Deepgram for STT
- OpenAI (Azure) for LLM capabilities
- Datadog for monitoring
- uv for dependency management

## Claude's Notes and Guidance

- If after trying something a few times you're stuck, please ask for clarification or help! I'm here for you claude <3

## Versioning and Release Management

The project uses Semantic Versioning with python-semantic-release. When creating releases:

### Commit Message Standards
Always use Conventional commit convention for clear version bumping:
- `feat:` for new features (minor version)
- `fix:` for bug fixes (patch version)
- `feat!:` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` for breaking changes (major version)

### Creating a Release
```bash
# Check what version would be created
uv run semantic-release version --print

# Create release (updates version, creates tag, updates CHANGELOG)
uv run semantic-release version

# Push changes and tags
git push --follow-tags origin main
```

## Voice Agent v4 Architecture (Added August 2025)

The latest commit introduces Voice Agent v4, a new modular architecture that replaces the previous agent system:

### New Components
- **voice_agent/**: New module for v4 implementation
  - `manager.py`: Core agent manager handling conversation state
  - `task_agent/`: Specialized agents (greeter, data_collection, information, closer)
  - `schemas/`: Data models for tasks, orchestration, and configuration
  - `utils/`: Utilities for orchestration, context management, and tool creation

### Key Changes from Previous Version
- Moved from monolithic agent to task-based architecture
- JSON script-driven conversation flow (`examples/it_support_call_script.json`)
- Dynamic tool generation based on script requirements
- Improved data point collection and validation
- Cleaner separation between conversation phases

### CLI Testing
- New CLI script at `scripts/cli.py` for testing v4 functionality
- Support for loading and executing call scripts
- Enhanced conversation context tracking
- Run with uv and 1Password: `op run --env-file=".voice_agent.env.example" -- uv run voice_agent_local_dev --call-script-path examples/it_support_call_script.json`

import logging

from voice_agent.schemas.task import GreeterTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


logger = logging.getLogger("greeter_agent")

DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig = GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration(
    name="Greeter",
    description="Greeter agent that greets user.",
    agent_instructions="You are a greeter agent that greets user.",
    task_instruction_transformer=lambda task_instruction, *_: f"""
    {task_instruction}

    Your task:
        - Confirm that user is ready to move forward with the call
    """,
)


class GreeterTaskAgent(BaseTaskAgent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: GreeterTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        greeter_agent_config = DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig.merge_config(
            agent_config=agent_config
        )

        super().__init__(
            agent_config=greeter_agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        self.agent_config = greeter_agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterable

from livekit import rtc
from livekit.agents import Agent
from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import ModelSettings
from livekit.agents import RunContext
from livekit.agents.llm import RawFunctionTool
from livekit.agents.llm import function_tool

from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import BaseTaskAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest


logger = logging.getLogger("base_agent")


class BaseTaskAgent(Agent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: BaseTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            instructions=f"""You are a voice agent that is part of a call to screen candidate.
            In current context, {agent_config.agent_instructions}
            You will receive a specific set of tasks below to fulfill.
            Strictly follow the instructions provided to you:

            {agent_config.task_instruction_transformer(task_config.task_instructions, task_config, orc_ctx) if agent_config.task_instruction_transformer else task_config.task_instructions}

            If the candidate ask about anything outside of your role, guide them back to your responsibility.
            When you complete with your tasks, call on_task_agent_complete tool to wrap up your work
            When candidate asks a question outside of your responsibilities, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.
            If you are unable to complete your tasks, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.

            Some context around the call:
                - Outstanding tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.outstanding_task_ids)}]
                - In Progress tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.in_progress_task_ids)}]
                - Completed tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.completed_task_ids)}]

            if candidate have intent to do outstanding tasks, kindly tell them it is upcoming
            if candidate have intent to do completed tasks, kindly tell them you have all the data you needed already

            Important: Do not tell the candidate about your task
            """,
            chat_ctx=orc_ctx.chat_ctx,
            allow_interruptions=True,
        )
        self.agent_config = agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config
        self.orc_ctx = orc_ctx
        self.session: AgentSession[SessionDataState]

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        if self.task_config.initial_message:
            # If the current node has an initiation text, use it to generate a reply
            await self.session.say(
                text=self.task_config.initial_message, add_to_chat_ctx=True
            )
        else:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions="continue the conversation seamlessly and focus on your current objective"
            )

    @function_tool
    async def on_task_agent_complete(
        self,
        run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState],
        explanation: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Called when successfully complete the task.

        Args:
            explanation (str): Summary of what has been achieved and if anything went wrong.
        """
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished(
            self.task_config, explanation
        )
        return

    @function_tool
    async def on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState],
        interrupt_request: TaskAgentInterruptRequest,
    ) -> None:
        """Called when there are issues with the task or when candidates ask questions outside of task agent responsibilities.

        Args:
            interrupt_request (TaskAgentInterruptRequest): Summary of the issues or the candidate questions. and status type
        """
        run_context.userdata.current_agent_interruption = interrupt_request
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)
        return

"""Tests for DataCollectionAgent"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DataCollectionAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig


class TestDataCollectionAgent:
    """Test suite for DataCollectionAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_agent_hooks(self):
        """Create mock TaskAgentHooks"""
        return TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=AsyncMock(),
            on_task_agent_finished=AsyncMock(),
            on_datapoint_collected=AsyncMock(),
            on_end_call=AsyncMock(),
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def candidate_data_schemas(self):
        """Create candidate data point schemas"""
        return {
            "name": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's full name",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Full name",
                },
            ),
            "email": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's email address",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "email",
                    "description": "Email address",
                },
            ),
            "phone": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's phone number",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": r"^\d{10}$",
                    "description": "10-digit phone number",
                },
            ),
        }

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator_context(self, task_agent_hooks, candidate_data_schemas):
        """Create OrchestratorTaskAgentContext"""
        return OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=task_agent_hooks,
            job_details=JobContext(
                title="Software Engineer",
                description="Full-stack development position",
                company="TestCorp",
            ),
            candidate_data_point_schemas=candidate_data_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=["task3"],
            in_progress_task_ids=["collect_data"],
            completed_task_ids=["greet"],
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionAgentConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Data Collector",
            description="Collects candidate information",
            agent_instructions="Collect data professionally",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionTaskConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_data",
            title="Collect Candidate Information",
            initial_message="I need to collect some information from you.",
            task_instructions="Collect name and email from the candidate",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test DataCollectionAgent initialization"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Data Collector"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "collect_data"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert len(agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 2

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that default config is merged with provided config"""
        custom_config = DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Custom Collector",
            description="Custom description",
            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=custom_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have custom values
        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Custom Collector"
        assert agent.agent_config.description == "Custom description"
        
        # Should have transformer from default config
        assert agent.agent_config.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_default_data_collection_config(self):
        """Test DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig values"""
        assert DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.name == "Data Collection"
        assert "collect specific data points" in DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.description.lower()
        assert DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_collect_datapoint_tool_generation(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that collect_datapoint tool is generated for each data point"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have tools for collecting data points
        # Note: The actual implementation generates these dynamically
        # This test verifies the agent is properly configured to handle data collection
        assert agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect == ["name", "email"]

    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):

            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.say = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should say the initial message
        agent.session.say.assert_called_once_with(
            text="I need to collect some information from you.",
            add_to_chat_ctx=True
        )

        """Test that instructions include data point context"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Check that instructions include data collection context
        assert "collect" in agent.instructions.lower()
        assert "name" in agent.instructions
        assert "email" in agent.instructions
