    async def test_task_completion_with_collected_data(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test data collection task completion"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()

        await agent.on_task_agent_complete(
            run_context=run_context,
            explanation="Successfully collected name and email"
        )

        # Should call the completion hook
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished.assert_called_once_with(
            task_config,
            "Successfully collected name and email"
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_interruption_during_collection(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test handling interruptions during data collection"""
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()
        run_context.userdata = MagicMock()

        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.UNABLE_TO_COMPLETE,
            interrupt_note="User refuses to provide email"
        )

        await agent.on_task_agent_interrupt(
            run_context=run_context,
            interrupt_request=interrupt_request
        )

        # Should handle the interruption
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt.assert_called_once_with(
            interrupt_request
        )

    def test_agent_type(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that agent type is correctly set"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.agent_type == TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION
        assert agent.task_config.task_agent_type == TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION

    def test_with_validation_strategies(self, agent_config, orchestrator_context, candidate_data_schemas):
        """Test data collection with validation strategies"""
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskValidationType
        from voice_agent.schemas.task import TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy

        task_config = DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_data",
            title="Collect and Validate",
            task_instructions="Collect and validate data",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
            validations=[
                TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(
                    strategy=TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY,
                    query="$.email",
                    instructions_on_failure="Please provide a valid email",
                    can_end_call=False,
                )
            ],
        )

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert len(agent.task_config.validations) == 1
        assert agent.task_config.validations[0].query == "$.email"

    def test_with_all_data_points(self, agent_config, orchestrator_context, candidate_data_schemas):
        """Test collecting all available data points"""
        task_config = DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_all",
            title="Collect All Data",
            task_instructions="Collect all candidate information",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email", "phone"],
        )

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert len(agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 3
        assert "phone" in agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect

"""Tests for DataCollectionAgent"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DataCollectionAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig


class TestDataCollectionAgent:
    """Test suite for DataCollectionAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_agent_hooks(self):
        """Create mock TaskAgentHooks"""
        return TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=AsyncMock(),
            on_task_agent_finished=AsyncMock(),
            on_datapoint_collected=AsyncMock(),
            on_end_call=AsyncMock(),
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def candidate_data_schemas(self):
        """Create candidate data point schemas"""
        return {
            "name": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's full name",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Full name",
                },
            ),
            "email": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's email address",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "email",
                    "description": "Email address",
                },
            ),
            "phone": CandidateDatapointDefinition(
                description="Candidate's phone number",
                output_schema={
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": r"^\d{10}$",
                    "description": "10-digit phone number",
                },
            ),
        }

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator_context(self, task_agent_hooks, candidate_data_schemas):
        """Create OrchestratorTaskAgentContext"""
        return OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=task_agent_hooks,
            job_details=JobContext(
                title="Software Engineer",
                description="Full-stack development position",
                company="TestCorp",
            ),
            candidate_data_point_schemas=candidate_data_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=["task3"],
            in_progress_task_ids=["collect_data"],
            completed_task_ids=["greet"],
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionAgentConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Data Collector",
            description="Collects candidate information",
            agent_instructions="Collect data professionally",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create DataCollectionTaskConfiguration"""
        return DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(
            id="collect_data",
            title="Collect Candidate Information",
            initial_message="I need to collect some information from you.",
            task_instructions="Collect name and email from the candidate",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
            candidate_data_points_to_collect=["name", "email"],
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test DataCollectionAgent initialization"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Data Collector"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "collect_data"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert len(agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) == 2

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that default config is merged with provided config"""
        custom_config = DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
            name="Custom Collector",
            description="Custom description",
            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        )

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=custom_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have custom values
        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Custom Collector"
        assert agent.agent_config.description == "Custom description"
        
        # Should have transformer from default config
        assert agent.agent_config.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_default_data_collection_config(self):
        """Test DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig values"""
        assert DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.name == "Data Collection"
        assert "collect specific data points" in DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.description.lower()
        assert DefaultDataCollectionAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_collect_datapoint_tool_generation(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that collect_datapoint tool is generated for each data point"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have tools for collecting data points
        # Note: The actual implementation generates these dynamically
        # This test verifies the agent is properly configured to handle data collection
        assert agent.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect == ["name", "email"]

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test on_enter behavior with initial message"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock session
        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.say = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should say the initial message
        agent.session.say.assert_called_once_with(
            text="I need to collect some information from you.",
            add_to_chat_ctx=True
        )

    def test_instructions_include_data_points(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that instructions include data point context"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Check that instructions include data collection context
        assert "collect" in agent.instructions.lower()
        assert "name" in agent.instructions
        assert "email" in agent.instructions

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_task_completion_with_collected_data(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test data collection task completion"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()

        await agent.on_task_agent_complete(
            run_context=run_context,
            explanation="Successfully collected name and email"
        )

        # Should call the completion hook
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished.assert_called_once_with(
            task_config,
            "Successfully collected name and email"
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_interruption_during_collection(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test handling interruptions during data collection"""
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest

        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        run_context.userdata = MagicMock()

        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(

            interrupt_note="User refuses to provide email"
        )

            run_context=run_context,
            interrupt_request=interrupt_request
        )

        # Should handle the interruption
        orchestrator_context.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt.assert_called_once_with(
            interrupt_request
        )

    def test_agent_type(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that agent type is correctly set"""
        agent = DataCollectionAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,

        assert agent.agent_config.agent_type == TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION

    def task_agent_hooks(self):

        return TaskAgentHooks(

            on_datapoint_collected=AsyncMock(),

                description="Full-stack development position",
                company="TestCorp",
                location="San Francisco, CA",

            job_details={
                "salary_range": "$120k-$160k",
                "benefits": "Health, dental, 401k",
            },
        )

        """Create InformationTaskConfiguration"""
        return InformationTaskConfiguration(

            task_instructions="Provide information about the job role and company",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        )

            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Info Provider"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "provide_info"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert agent.agent_config.job_details["salary_range"] == "$120k-$160k"

            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",

        assert DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None

class TestCloserTaskAgent:
    """Test suite for CloserTaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_agent_hooks(self):

    def task_config(self):

            task_instructions="Thank the candidate and end the call professionally",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        )

            agent_config=agent_config,

            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):

            name="Custom Closer",

            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,

        # Should have transformer from default config

        """Test DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig values"""

        assert "close the conversation" in DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig.description.lower()
        assert DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_task_instruction_transformer(self):
        """Test the task instruction transformer"""

        assert "Original instruction" in result
        assert "Your task:" in result
        assert "Thank the candidate" in result
        assert "end the conversation" in result.lower()

from voice_agent.task_agent.information_agent import InformationTaskAgent

from .conversation_context import VoiceAgentConversationContext


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class CallScriptOrchestrator:
    def __init__(
        self,
        call_script: CallScript,
        session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        on_finish_cleanup: Callable[[str], Awaitable[Any]],
    ):
        self.session = session
        self.on_finish_cleanup = on_finish_cleanup

        self.job_details = call_script.context.job
        self.candidate_datapoint_schemas = call_script.candidate_data_point_schemas

        self.conversation_context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()

        self.task_map: dict[str, TaskConfiguration] = {
            task.id: task for task in call_script.tasks
        }
        self.outstanding_task_ids: list[str] = [task.id for task in call_script.tasks]
        self.in_progress_task_ids: list[str] = []
        self.completed_task_ids: list[str] = []
        self.failed_tasks: list[OrchestratorFailedTask] = []

        self.task_agent_hooks: TaskAgentHooks = TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=self.on_task_agent_interrupt,
            on_task_agent_finished=self.on_task_agent_finished,
            on_datapoint_collected=self.on_candidate_datapoint_collected,
            on_end_call=self.on_end_call,
        )

        logger.debug(
            f"Initialized CallScriptOrchestrator with call_script: {call_script.id} - {call_script.call_script_version}"
        )

    async def start(
        self, ctx: JobContext, room_input_options: RoomInputOptions
    ) -> None:
        await ctx.connect(auto_subscribe=AutoSubscribe.AUDIO_ONLY)
        task = self._get_next_task()
        if not task:
            await self.done("No Tasks to start. Ending Session")
            return
        agent = self._load_task_agent(task)
        logger.debug("Agent loaded")
        await self.session.start(
            room=ctx.room, agent=agent, room_input_options=room_input_options
        )
        logger.debug(f"Voice Agent Session started with task: {task.id} - {task.title}")

    async def on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self, interrupt_request: TaskAgentInterruptRequest
    ) -> None:
        if interrupt_request.type == TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions="Acknowledge candidate reason for ending call and thank them for their time."
            )
            await self.on_end_call(interrupt_request.interrupt_note)
            self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
            return
        ## TODO: PLACEHOLDER FOR NOW
        await self.session.generate_reply(
            instructions=f"Apology to the candidate for `{interrupt_request.interrupt_note}` and redirect candidate focus back to the task at hand."
        )
        self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
        return

    async def on_task_agent_finished(
        self, current_agent_task: BaseTaskConfiguration, explanation: str
    ) -> None:
        logger.debug(
            f"current state: {self.session.userdata.model_dump_json(indent=2)}"
        )
        self.conversation_context.update_from_chat_context(self.session._chat_ctx)
        self._complete_task(current_agent_task)
        next_task = self._get_next_task()
        if not next_task:
            await self.done(explanation)
            return
        self.session.update_agent(self._load_task_agent(next_task))
        return

    async def on_candidate_datapoint_collected(
        self, key: str, value: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        logger.debug(f"Collected datapoint: {key} - {value}")
        return

    async def on_end_call(self, reason: str) -> None:
        # Move all in-progress tasks to completed tasks
        for task_id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            if task_id not in self.completed_task_ids:
                self.completed_task_ids.append(task_id)
        self.in_progress_task_ids.clear()
        logger.debug(f"Final State: {self.session.userdata.model_dump_json(indent=2)}")
        logger.debug(f"Completed Tasks: {self.completed_task_ids}")
        logger.debug(f"Outstanding Tasks: {self.outstanding_task_ids}")
        logger.debug(f"Failed Tasks: {self.failed_tasks}")
        logger.debug(f"Conversation: {self.conversation_context}")
        await self.done(reason)

    async def done(self, reason: str = "") -> None:
        await self.on_finish_cleanup(reason)
        logger.debug(f"Voice Agent Session ended with reason: {reason}")

    def _get_next_task(self) -> TaskConfiguration | None:
        # If there are items in in_progress_task_ids, take the last item from the list
        if self.in_progress_task_ids:
            task_id = self.in_progress_task_ids[-1]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # Otherwise get the first item from outstanding_task_ids
        if self.outstanding_task_ids:
            task_id = self.outstanding_task_ids[0]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # If both lists are empty
        return None

    def _complete_task(self, task: BaseTaskConfiguration) -> None:
        """
        Completes a task by removing it from in_progress_task_ids, outstanding_task_ids, and adding it to completed_task_ids.
        """
        if task.id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            self.in_progress_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        if task.id in self.outstanding_task_ids:
            self.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        self.completed_task_ids.append(task.id)

    def _load_task_agent(self, task: TaskConfiguration) -> BaseTaskAgent:
        logger.debug(
            f"Loading Task Agent for task: {task.id} with agent {task.task_agent_type}"
        )
        chat_ctx = self.conversation_context.generate_context(
            remove_last_user_responses=False
        )

        orchestration_ctx = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=self.task_agent_hooks,
            chat_ctx=chat_ctx,
            job_details=self.job_details,
            candidate_data_point_schemas=self.candidate_datapoint_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=self.outstanding_task_ids,
            completed_task_ids=self.completed_task_ids,
            in_progress_task_ids=self.in_progress_task_ids,
        )

        match task.task_agent_type:
            case TaskAgentType.GREETING:
                return GreeterTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION:
                return DataCollectionTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.INFORMATION:
                return InformationTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultInformationTaskAgent,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.CLOSER:
                return CloserTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case _:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown task agent type: {task.task_agent_type}")

    async def done(self, reason: str = "") -> None:
        await self.on_finish_cleanup(reason)
        logger.debug(f"Voice Agent Session ended with reason: {reason}")

    def _get_next_task(self) -> TaskConfiguration | None:
        # If there are items in in_progress_task_ids, take the last item from the list
        if self.in_progress_task_ids:
            task_id = self.in_progress_task_ids[-1]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # Otherwise get the first item from outstanding_task_ids
        if self.outstanding_task_ids:
            task_id = self.outstanding_task_ids[0]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # If both lists are empty
        return None

    def _complete_task(self, task: BaseTaskConfiguration) -> None:
        """
        Completes a task by removing it from in_progress_task_ids, outstanding_task_ids, and adding it to completed_task_ids.
        """
        if task.id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            self.in_progress_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        if task.id in self.outstanding_task_ids:
            self.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        self.completed_task_ids.append(task.id)

    def _load_task_agent(self, task: TaskConfiguration) -> BaseTaskAgent:
        logger.debug(
            f"Loading Task Agent for task: {task.id} with agent {task.task_agent_type}"
        )
        chat_ctx = self.conversation_context.generate_context(
            remove_last_user_responses=False
        )

        orchestration_ctx = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=self.task_agent_hooks,
            chat_ctx=chat_ctx,
            job_details=self.job_details,
            candidate_data_point_schemas=self.candidate_datapoint_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=self.outstanding_task_ids,
            completed_task_ids=self.completed_task_ids,
            in_progress_task_ids=self.in_progress_task_ids,
        )

        match task.task_agent_type:
            case TaskAgentType.GREETING:
                return GreeterTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION:
                return DataCollectionTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.INFORMATION:
                return InformationTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultInformationTaskAgent,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.CLOSER:
                return CloserTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case _:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown task agent type: {task.task_agent_type}")

from enum import StrEnum


class TaskValidationType(StrEnum):
    # validation using query against data point (leveraging jsonata) - e.g years_experience > 5 && years_experience < 10
    CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY = "CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY"
    # For future reference, natural language validation - e.g "candidates have some experience in management a small to medium team"

    # AI_QUERY = "AI_QUERY"


class TaskFailureBehavior(StrEnum):
    # Re-try agent
    RETRY = "RETRY"
    # Move to next task
    SKIP = "SKIP"
    # End the call
    END_CALL = "END_CALL"


class TaskProgrammaticAction(StrEnum):
    END_CALL = "END_CALL"
    NEXT_TASK = "NEXT_TASK"


class TaskAgentInterruptType(StrEnum):

import logging
from typing import Any
from typing import cast

from livekit.agents import RunContext
from livekit.agents import ToolError

from voice_agent.enums import TaskProgrammaticAction
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.datapoint_validator import CandidateDatapointValidator
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_datapoint_tools
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_hangup_tool

from .base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


logger = logging.getLogger("data_collection_agent")


def data_collection_task_instruction_transformer(
    task_instruction: str | None,
    task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
    orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
) -> str:
    data_collection_task_config = cast(DataCollectionTaskConfiguration, task_config)

    data_point_descriptions = "\n".join(
        f"- {data_point}: {orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas[data_point].description}"
        for data_point in data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
    )

    return f"""
    {task_instruction}

    Here are the data points you need to collect:
        {data_point_descriptions}

    Here are all information about the role: {orc_ctx.job_details.model_dump_json()}

    Your task:
        - Collect all required data points using the appropriate collection tools
        - Each data point has a specific collection function - use the correct one
        - Validate responses and use the appropriate tool to record them
        - If a candidate provides unclear information, ask for clarification before collecting
        - If a candidate provides data that is drastically deviated from job expectations, ask for clarification before collecting
        - Once all data points are collected, complete your task

import json
import pytest
from pathlib import Path

from livekit.agents import JobContext

class TestVoiceAgentIntegration:
    """Integration tests for complete voice agent workflows"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_livekit_dependencies(self):
        """Mock all LiveKit dependencies"""
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.deepgram.STT") as mock_stt, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.cartesia.TTS") as mock_tts, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.openai.LLM") as mock_llm, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.silero.VAD") as mock_vad, \
             patch("voice_agent.manager.noise_cancellation.BVC") as mock_bvc, \
             patch("voice_agent.utils.orchestrator.RoomInputOptions") as mock_room_input:
            
            # Configure basic mocks
            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())
            mock_llm_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_llm_instance.complete = AsyncMock(return_value='{"name": "John Doe", "email": "john@example.com"}')
            mock_llm.return_value = mock_llm_instance
            
            yield {
                "stt": mock_stt,
                "tts": mock_tts,
                "llm": mock_llm,
                "llm_instance": mock_llm_instance,
                "vad": mock_vad,
                "bvc": mock_bvc,
                "room_input": mock_room_input,
            }

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_complete_call_flow(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_livekit_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test a complete call flow from greeting to closing"""
        # Setup agent session mock
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session_class:
            mock_session = MagicMock()
            mock_session.say = AsyncMock()
            mock_session.close = AsyncMock()
            mock_session.start = AsyncMock()
            mock_session.userdata = MagicMock()
            mock_session.userdata.current_task_id = None
            mock_session.userdata.task_history = []
            mock_session.userdata.collected_data = {}
            mock_session_class.return_value = mock_session
            
            # Create manager
            manager = VoiceAgentManager(
                ctx=mock_job_context,
                call_script=sample_call_script,
            )
            
            # Mock orchestrator to simulate task execution
            with patch.object(manager.call_script_orchestrator, "execute_next_task") as mock_execute:
                mock_execute.side_effect = [
                    None,  # After greeting
                    None,  # After data collection
                    None,  # After information
                    None,  # After closing
                ]
                
                # Start the session
                await manager.start_session()
                
                # Verify orchestrator was started
                assert manager.call_script_orchestrator.start.called

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_data_collection_with_validation(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_livekit_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test data collection with validation and retry"""
        # Create a script focused on data collection
        script = CallScript(
            name="Data Collection Test",
            description="Test data collection",
            tasks=[
                {
                    "id": "collect",
                    "type": "data_collection",
                    "name": "Collect Info",
                    "instructions": "Collect user information",
                    "messages": ["Please provide your information"],
                    "data_points": [
                        {
                            "key": "email",
                            "description": "Email address",
                            "required": True,
                            "validation_regex": r"^[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+\.\w+$",
                        }
                    ],
                    "max_attempts": 3,
                }
            ],
        )
        
        with patch("voice_agent.manager.AgentSession") as mock_session_class:
            mock_session = MagicMock()
            mock_session.say = AsyncMock()
            mock_session.userdata = MagicMock()

    )

            patch("voice_agent.manager.CallScriptOrchestrator") as mock_orchestrator,
        ):

            mock_vad.load = Mock(return_value=MagicMock())

            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()

            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance

            yield {
                "stt": mock_stt,
                "tts": mock_tts,
                "llm": mock_llm,
                "vad": mock_vad,
                "session": mock_session,
                "session_instance": mock_session_instance,
                "orchestrator": mock_orchestrator,
                "orchestrator_instance": mock_orchestrator_instance,
            }

    def test_initialization(
        self,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        voice_agent_config: VoiceAgentConfig,
        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test VoiceAgentManager initialization"""
        manager = VoiceAgentManager(
            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            config=voice_agent_config,
        )

        # Verify components are initialized
        assert manager.ctx == mock_job_context
        assert manager.call_script == sample_call_script
        assert manager.config == voice_agent_config

        # Verify STT initialization
        mock_dependencies["stt"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.deepgram_model,
            language=voice_agent_config.deepgram_language,
        )

        # Verify TTS initialization
        mock_dependencies["tts"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.cartesia_model,
            voice=voice_agent_config.default_cartesia_voice,
        )

        # Verify LLM initialization
        mock_dependencies["llm"].assert_called_once_with(
            model=voice_agent_config.llm_model
        )

        # Verify VAD initialization
        mock_dependencies["vad"].load.assert_called_once()

        # Verify orchestrator initialization
        mock_dependencies["orchestrator"].assert_called_once()

        mock_dependencies,
    ):
        """Test initialization with default config"""

            ctx=mock_job_context,
            call_script=sample_call_script,
        )

        # Should use default config values
        assert manager.config.llm_model == "gpt-4o-mini"
        assert manager.config.deepgram_model == "nova-2"

import pytest

from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_session(self) -> AgentSession:
        """Create a mock AgentSession"""
        session = Mock(spec=AgentSession)
        session.userdata = MagicMock()
        session.userdata.current_task_id = None
        session.userdata.task_history = []
        session.userdata.collected_data = {}
        session.say = AsyncMock()
        session.on_close = AsyncMock()
        session.close = AsyncMock()
        return session

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ) -> CallScriptOrchestrator:
        """Create a CallScriptOrchestrator instance"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        return CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )
        
        assert orchestrator.session == mock_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        with patch.object(orchestrator.session, "start") as mock_start:
            mock_start.return_value = AsyncMock()
            
            with patch.object(orchestrator, "_get_next_task") as mock_get_task:
                mock_get_task.return_value = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
                
                with patch.object(orchestrator, "_load_task_agent") as mock_load:
                    mock_load.return_value = MagicMock()
                    
                    await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
                
                mock_start.assert_called_once()
                mock_execute.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_next_task_success(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test executing the next task successfully"""
        # Create a mock agent
        mock_agent = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.process_task = AsyncMock(
            return_value=TaskResult(
                task_id="greet",
                success=True,
                message="Greeting completed",
            )
        )
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "create_task_agent", return_value=mock_agent):
            await orchestrator.execute_next_task()
            
            # Should have moved to next task
            assert orchestrator.current_task_index == 1
            assert orchestrator.session.userdata.current_task_id == "collect_issue"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_next_task_failure_retry(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test retrying a failed task"""
        orchestrator.current_task_index = 1  # Start at data collection task
        
        # Create a mock agent that fails

        mock_agent.process_task = AsyncMock(

                success=False,

        mock_agent.context = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.context.attempt_count = 1
        mock_agent.context.max_attempts = 3
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "create_task_agent", return_value=mock_agent):
            await orchestrator.execute_next_task()
            
            # Should stay on the same task (retry)
            assert orchestrator.current_task_index == 1

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_next_task_max_attempts_reached(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,

        orchestrator.current_task_index = 1  # Start at data collection task

        mock_agent = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.process_task = AsyncMock(
            return_value=TaskResult(
                task_id="collect_issue",
                success=False,
                message="Max attempts reached",
            )
        )
        mock_agent.context = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.context.attempt_count = 3
        mock_agent.context.max_attempts = 3
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "create_task_agent", return_value=mock_agent):

"""Tests for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_session(self) -> AgentSession:
        """Create a mock AgentSession"""
        session = Mock(spec=AgentSession)
        session.userdata = MagicMock()
        session.userdata.current_task_id = None
        session.userdata.task_history = []
        session.userdata.collected_data = {}
        session.say = AsyncMock()
        session.on_close = AsyncMock()
        session.close = AsyncMock()
        return session

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ) -> CallScriptOrchestrator:
        """Create a CallScriptOrchestrator instance"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        return CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )
        
        assert orchestrator.session == mock_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        with patch.object(orchestrator.session, "start") as mock_start:
            mock_start.return_value = AsyncMock()
            
            with patch.object(orchestrator, "_get_next_task") as mock_get_task:
                mock_get_task.return_value = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
                
                with patch.object(orchestrator, "_load_task_agent") as mock_load:
                    mock_load.return_value = MagicMock()
                    
                    await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
                
                mock_start.assert_called_once()
                mock_execute.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
    ):
        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)
        
        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")
        
        # Should have moved task to completed
        assert task.id in orchestrator.completed_task_ids
        assert task.id not in orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test handling task interruption"""
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        
        # Create interrupt request
        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User changed topic"
        )
        
        # Test topic change doesn't end call
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)
        
        # Test end call interrupt
        end_call_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL,
            interrupt_note="User wants to end call"
        )
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done") as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(end_call_request)
            mock_done.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_next_task_max_attempts_reached(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test moving to next task after max attempts"""
        orchestrator.current_task_index = 1  # Start at data collection task
        
        # Create a mock agent that fails with max attempts reached
        mock_agent = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.process_task = AsyncMock(
            return_value=TaskResult(
                task_id="collect_issue",
                success=False,
                message="Max attempts reached",
            )
        )
        mock_agent.context = MagicMock()
        mock_agent.context.attempt_count = 3
        mock_agent.context.max_attempts = 3
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "create_task_agent", return_value=mock_agent):
            await orchestrator.execute_next_task()
            
            # Should move to next task despite failure
            assert orchestrator.current_task_index == 2

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_execute_all_tasks_complete(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test completion of all tasks"""
        orchestrator.current_task_index = len(orchestrator.call_script.tasks)
        
        await orchestrator.execute_next_task()
        
        # Should call on_finish_cleanup
        orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup.assert_called_once_with("All tasks completed")

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

        session.userdata.collected_data = {}
        session.say = AsyncMock()
        session.on_close = AsyncMock()
        session.close = AsyncMock()
        return session

    def orchestrator(
        self,

        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ) -> CallScriptOrchestrator:
        """Create a CallScriptOrchestrator instance"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        return CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,

        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )
        
        assert orchestrator.session == mock_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

        self,

        with patch.object(orchestrator.session, "start") as mock_start:
            mock_start.return_value = AsyncMock()
            
            with patch.object(orchestrator, "_get_next_task") as mock_get_task:
                mock_get_task.return_value = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
                
                with patch.object(orchestrator, "_load_task_agent") as mock_load:
                    mock_load.return_value = MagicMock()
                    
                    await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
                
                mock_start.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,

        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)
        
        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")
        
        # Should have moved task to completed
        assert task.id in orchestrator.completed_task_ids
        assert task.id not in orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
    ):
        """Test handling task interruption"""
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        
        # Create interrupt request
        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User changed topic"
        )
        
        # Test topic change doesn't end call
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)
        
        # Test end call interrupt
        end_call_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL,
            interrupt_note="User wants to end call"
        )
        
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done") as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(end_call_request)
            mock_done.assert_called_once()

"""Tests for VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext"""

import pytest

from voice_agent.utils.conversation_context import (
    VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext,
)


class TestVoiceAgentConversationContext:
    """Test suite for VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def context(self) -> VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext:
        """Create a VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext instance"""
        return VoiceAgentVoiceAgentConversationContext()

    def test_initialization(self):
        """Test VoiceAgentConversationContext initialization"""
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext(max_history=5)

        assert context.max_history == 5
        assert len(context.messages) == 0
        assert context.get_context() == []

    def test_default_initialization(self):
        """Test default initialization values"""
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()

        assert context.max_history == 10
        assert len(context.messages) == 0

    def test_add_message_user(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test adding user messages"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello there")

        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "user"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hello there"

    def test_add_message_assistant(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test adding assistant messages"""
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi! How can I help?")

        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "assistant"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hi! How can I help?"

    def test_add_message_system(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test adding system messages"""
        context.add_message("system", "You are a helpful assistant")

        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "system"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "You are a helpful assistant"

    def test_add_multiple_messages(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test adding multiple messages"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi there!")
        context.add_message("user", "How are you?")
        context.add_message("assistant", "I'm doing well, thanks!")

        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 4
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Hello"
        assert messages[1]["content"] == "Hi there!"
        assert messages[2]["content"] == "How are you?"
        assert messages[3]["content"] == "I'm doing well, thanks!"

    def test_max_history_limit(self):
        """Test that max_history is enforced"""
        context = VoiceAgentConversationContext(max_history=3)

        # Add more messages than max_history
        context.add_message("user", "Message 1")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response 1")
        context.add_message("user", "Message 2")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response 2")
        context.add_message("user", "Message 3")

        messages = context.get_context()
        assert len(messages) == 3
        # Should keep the most recent messages
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Message 2"
        assert messages[1]["content"] == "Response 2"
        assert messages[2]["content"] == "Message 3"

    def test_clear_context(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test clearing conversation context"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi!")

        assert len(context.get_context()) == 2

        context.clear()

        assert len(context.get_context()) == 0

    def test_get_last_message(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last message"""
        context.add_message("user", "First")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Second")
        context.add_message("user", "Last")

        last = context.get_last_message()
        assert last is not None
        assert last["role"] == "user"
        assert last["content"] == "Last"

    def test_get_last_message_empty(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test getting last message from empty context"""
        last = context.get_last_message()
        assert last is None

    def test_get_last_user_message(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last user message"""
        context.add_message("user", "User 1")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Response")
        context.add_message("user", "User 2")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Another response")

        last_user = context.get_last_user_message()
        assert last_user is not None
        assert last_user["content"] == "User 2"

    def test_get_last_assistant_message(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test getting the last assistant message"""
        context.add_message("user", "Question")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Answer 1")
        context.add_message("user", "Another question")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Answer 2")

        last_assistant = context.get_last_assistant_message()
        assert last_assistant is not None
        assert last_assistant["content"] == "Answer 2"

    def test_get_formatted_context(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test getting formatted context string"""
        context.add_message("user", "Hello")
        context.add_message("assistant", "Hi there!")

        formatted = context.get_formatted_context()
        assert "User: Hello" in formatted
        assert "Assistant: Hi there!" in formatted

    def test_empty_formatted_context(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test formatted context when empty"""
        formatted = context.get_formatted_context()
        assert formatted == ""

    def test_message_count(self, context: VoiceAgentConversationContext):
        """Test message counting"""
        assert context.message_count() == 0

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType

from voice_agent.schemas.task import InformationTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import InformationTaskAgentConfiguration

from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.task_agent.information_agent import DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig
from voice_agent.task_agent.information_agent import InformationTaskAgent


class TestInformationTaskAgent:
    """Test suite for InformationTaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_agent_hooks(self):
        """Create mock TaskAgentHooks"""
        return TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=AsyncMock(),
            on_task_agent_finished=AsyncMock(),
            on_datapoint_collected=AsyncMock(),
            on_end_call=AsyncMock(),
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator_context(self, task_agent_hooks):
        """Create OrchestratorTaskAgentContext"""
        return OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=task_agent_hooks,
            job_details=JobContext(
                title="Software Engineer",
                description="Full-stack development position",
                company="TestCorp",
                location="San Francisco, CA",
            ),
            candidate_data_point_schemas={},
            outstanding_task_ids=["close"],
            in_progress_task_ids=["provide_info"],
            completed_task_ids=["greet", "collect_data"],
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create InformationTaskAgentConfiguration"""
        return InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Info Provider",
            description="Provides job information",
            agent_instructions="Provide detailed information clearly",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
            job_details={
                "salary_range": "$120k-$160k",
                "benefits": "Health, dental, 401k",
            },
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create InformationTaskConfiguration"""
        return InformationTaskConfiguration(
            id="provide_info",
            title="Provide Job Information",
            initial_message="Let me tell you about this position.",
            task_instructions="Provide information about the job role and company",
            task_agent_type=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test InformationTaskAgent initialization"""
        agent = InformationTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Info Provider"
        assert agent.task_config.id == "provide_info"
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert agent.agent_config.job_details["salary_range"] == "$120k-$160k"

    def test_default_config_merge(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test that default config is merged with provided config"""
        custom_config = InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Custom Info Agent",
            description="Custom description",
            agent_instructions="Custom instructions",
            agent_type=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        )

        agent = InformationTaskAgent(
            agent_config=custom_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Should have custom values
        assert agent.agent_config.name == "Custom Info Agent"
        assert agent.agent_config.description == "Custom description"

        # Should have transformer from default config
        assert agent.agent_config.task_instruction_transformer is not None

    def test_default_information_config(self):
        """Test DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig values"""
        assert DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig.name == "Information"
        assert (
            "provide information"
            in DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig.description.lower()
        )
        assert (
            DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer is not None
        )

    def test_task_instruction_transformer(self):
        """Test the task instruction transformer"""
        transformer = DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig.task_instruction_transformer
        assert transformer is not None

        result = transformer("Original instruction", None, None)

        assert "Original instruction" in result
        assert "Your task:" in result
        assert "Provide the candidate with relevant information" in result

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(

    ):

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

This is the Purplefish AI voice agent - a LiveKit-based phone agent for conducting automated voice interviews. The agent uses WebRTC for real-time communication, Deepgram for speech-to-text, and various TTS providers (Cartesia, Google).

## Essential Commands

We have a `Makefile` that simplifies common tasks. Here are the key commands:

### Development
- `make dev` - Run the agent in development mode
- `make test` - Run all tests
- `make test path=tests/path/to/test.py::test_name` - Run specific test
- `make download-files` - Download required model files (run after initial setup)

### Code Quality
- `make check` - Run all linting and formatting checks
- uv manages dependencies - use `uv add` for new packages
- Type checking is strict (mypy with strict=true)
- **Note**: For `voice_agent/` module and `tests/voice_agent/` tests, use pyright instead of mypy for type checking

## Architecture

The agent initialization flow:

1. **CLI Entry**: `agent/__init__.py` - Main entry point that parses commands (start, dev, chat, simulate, replay)
2. **Agent Setup**: `agent/entrypoint.py` - Sets up LiveKit room, loads AI components, creates CallController
3. **Call Management**: `agent/call_controller.py` - Manages voice conversations using AgentManager
4. **Agent Stack**: `agent/agent_manager.py` - Manages transitions between different agent types

Key components:
- **Agent Types** (`agent/agents/`): Different conversation handlers (question, reschedule, transfer, etc.)
- **Services** (`agent/services/`): External integrations with LiveKit, Purplefish API, analytics
- **Schemas** (`agent/schemas/`): Data models for profiles, jobs, scripts, and user data
- **Script Nodes**: Define conversation flow, converted to agents at runtime

Key patterns:
- All code is async (asyncio)
- Service interfaces separate external dependencies
- Agent stack allows dynamic conversation state changes
- Extensive Pydantic usage for data validation

## Testing

Tests use pytest with async support. The codebase includes:
- Unit tests for individual components
- Integration tests for agent behaviors

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

This is the Purplefish AI voice agent - a LiveKit-based phone agent for conducting automated voice interviews. The agent uses WebRTC for real-time communication, Deepgram for speech-to-text, and various TTS providers (Cartesia, Google).

## Essential Commands

We have a `Makefile` that simplifies common tasks. Here are the key commands:

### Development
- `make dev` - Run the agent in development mode
- `make test` - Run all tests
- `make test path=tests/path/to/test.py::test_name` - Run specific test
- `make download-files` - Download required model files (run after initial setup)

### Code Quality
- `make check` - Run all linting and formatting checks
- uv manages dependencies - use `uv add` for new packages
- Type checking is strict (mypy with strict=true)
- **Note**: For `voice_agent/` module and `tests/voice_agent/` tests, use pyright instead of mypy for type checking

## Architecture

The agent initialization flow:

1. **CLI Entry**: `agent/__init__.py` - Main entry point that parses commands (start, dev, chat, simulate, replay)
2. **Agent Setup**: `agent/entrypoint.py` - Sets up LiveKit room, loads AI components, creates CallController
3. **Call Management**: `agent/call_controller.py` - Manages voice conversations using AgentManager
4. **Agent Stack**: `agent/agent_manager.py` - Manages transitions between different agent types

Key components:
- **Agent Types** (`agent/agents/`): Different conversation handlers (question, reschedule, transfer, etc.)
- **Services** (`agent/services/`): External integrations with LiveKit, Purplefish API, analytics
- **Schemas** (`agent/schemas/`): Data models for profiles, jobs, scripts, and user data
- **Script Nodes**: Define conversation flow, converted to agents at runtime

Key patterns:
- All code is async (asyncio)
- Service interfaces separate external dependencies
- Agent stack allows dynamic conversation state changes
- Extensive Pydantic usage for data validation

## Testing

Tests use pytest with async support. The codebase includes:
- Unit tests for individual components
- Integration tests for agent behaviors
- Simulation tools for end-to-end testing without real calls

When writing tests:
- Use `pytest.mark.asyncio` for async tests
- Mock external services via service interfaces
- Test files should mirror source structure

## Environment Configuration

The project uses 1Password CLI for secrets management. Environment files are in `envs/`:
- Development uses `envs/development.env`
- All commands automatically load appropriate env via `op run`
- Never commit secrets - use 1Password references

## Key Dependencies

- LiveKit SDK and plugins for WebRTC
- Deepgram for STT
- OpenAI (Azure) for LLM capabilities
- Datadog for monitoring
- uv for dependency management

## Claude's Notes and Guidance

- If after trying something a few times you're stuck, please ask for clarification or help! I'm here for you claude <3

## Versioning and Release Management

The project uses Semantic Versioning with python-semantic-release. When creating releases:

### Commit Message Standards
Always use Conventional commit convention for clear version bumping:
- `feat:` for new features (minor version)
- `fix:` for bug fixes (patch version)
- `feat!:` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` for breaking changes (major version)

### Creating a Release
```bash
# Check what version would be created
uv run semantic-release version --print

# Create release (updates version, creates tag, updates CHANGELOG)
uv run semantic-release version

# Push changes and tags
git push --follow-tags origin main
```

## Voice Agent v4 Architecture (Added August 2025)

The latest commit introduces Voice Agent v4, a new modular architecture that replaces the previous agent system:

### New Components
- **voice_agent/**: New module for v4 implementation
  - `manager.py`: Core agent manager handling conversation state
  - `task_agent/`: Specialized agents (greeter, data_collection, information, closer)
  - `schemas/`: Data models for tasks, orchestration, and configuration
  - `utils/`: Utilities for orchestration, context management, and tool creation

### Key Changes from Previous Version
- Moved from monolithic agent to task-based architecture
- JSON script-driven conversation flow (`examples/it_support_call_script.json`)
- Dynamic tool generation based on script requirements
- Improved data point collection and validation
- Cleaner separation between conversation phases

### CLI Testing
- New CLI script at `scripts/cli.py` for testing v4 functionality
- Support for loading and executing call scripts
- Enhanced conversation context tracking
- Run with uv and 1Password: `op run --env-file=".voice_agent.env.example" -- uv run voice_agent_local_dev --call-script-path examples/it_support_call_script.json`

"""
Call Conversation Context Manager
Manages chat history and generates modified ChatContext instances for LiveKit agents
"""

import logging

from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatItem
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentConversationContext:
    """
    Manages conversation history and generates modified ChatContext instances.
    Stores chat items immutably and applies modifications only when generating output.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize empty conversation context"""
        self._items: list[ChatItem] = []
        self._item_ids: set[str] = set()  # Track seen item IDs to avoid duplicates

    def update_from_chat_context(self, chat_ctx: ChatContext) -> None:
        """
        Update internal storage with new items from LiveKit's ChatContext.
        Only adds items that haven't been seen before.

        Args:
            chat_ctx: LiveKit ChatContext to sync from
        """
        if not chat_ctx or not chat_ctx.items:
            return

        added_count = 0
        for item in chat_ctx.items:
            # Check if item has an ID and hasn't been seen
            if isinstance(item, ChatMessage) and hasattr(item, "id"):
                if item.id and item.id not in self._item_ids:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    self._item_ids.add(item.id)
                    added_count += 1
            else:
                # For items without IDs, check if it's already in our list
                # This is a simple check - you might want more sophisticated duplicate detection
                if item not in self._items:
                    self._items.append(item)

"""Tests for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.fixture
    def mock_session(self) -> AgentSession:
        """Create a mock AgentSession"""
        session = Mock(spec=AgentSession)
        session.userdata = MagicMock()
        session.userdata.current_task_id = None
        session.userdata.task_history = []
        session.userdata.collected_data = {}
        session.say = AsyncMock()
        session.on_close = AsyncMock()
        session.close = AsyncMock()
        return session

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ) -> CallScriptOrchestrator:
        """Create a CallScriptOrchestrator instance"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        return CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_session: AgentSession,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )
        
        assert orchestrator.session == mock_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        with patch.object(orchestrator.session, "start") as mock_start:
            mock_start.return_value = AsyncMock()
            
            with patch.object(orchestrator, "_get_next_task") as mock_get_task:
                mock_get_task.return_value = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
                
                with patch.object(orchestrator, "_load_task_agent") as mock_load:
                    mock_load.return_value = MagicMock()
                    
                    await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
                
                mock_start.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        orchestrator: CallScriptOrchestrator,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
    ):
        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)
        
        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")
        
        # Should have moved task to completed
